Who became the first US dollar trillionaire in June 2026?

[Trillionaire] A trillionaire is a person whose net worth is at least one trillion units of a given currency, typically the US dollar due to its status as a world currency. The only person to reach trillionaire status in terms of US dollars is Elon Musk, who first reached trillionaire status upon the initial public offering of his company SpaceX in 2026. Musk's net worth is highly concentrated in SpaceX, and SpaceX debuted at a record valuation of nearly US$2 trillion. Since then, SpaceX's volatile stock price has primarily influenced Musk's net worth, with its fluctuations causing him to lose and reclaim trillionaire status several times. Several other currencies have had their own trillionaires, sometimes owing to hyperinflation.
The first US dollar trillionaire in June 2026 was Elon Musk. FINAL: Elon Musk
